title: Normalized derived scalar endpoints of the residue root line
statement: For the finite purity setting and any k-scheme T, the residue root tensor line has its generator-normalized coefficient insertion into the A root line. Its degree-zero and shifted adjunction transposes are isomorphisms. The two adjuncts are the actual degree-zero scalar unit and its canonical shift comparison.

source.place: Section 9, Example 9.5 and the Ext proof of Theorem 9.4, pp. 66–67; Stacks Tags 03FD, 093X, 06YY, 07A6 and 099R

proof.text: Apply the existing finite Kummer scalar endpoint existence theorem to the lifted residue ring, the coefficient ring and their canonical map. The diagonal exponent is positive and invertible on T. Its normalized line insertion supplies theta and its line isomorphism supplies c.

Unfold the derived insertion to identify its adjunct with the degree-zero scalar unit. Compose the canonical left-adjoint shift comparison with the shifted c to construct c2. Naturality of the right-adjoint shift comparison and its unit compatibility compute the adjunct of c2 as the prescribed shifted unit.

lean.statement:
theorem rootScalarEndpointData
    (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (T : Scheme.{u})
    [T.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] :
    ∃ theta : rootModule P T ⟶ (Sheaf.restrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology (scalar P)).obj
        (P.frameTwistEtale T 1),
    ∃ c : (Etale.scalarExtension (scalar P) T).obj
        (SheafExactDegreeZero.obj _ (rootModule P T)) ≅
          SheafExactDegreeZero.obj _ (P.frameTwistEtale T 1),
    ∃ c2 : (Etale.scalarExtension (scalar P) T).obj
        ((SheafExactDegreeZero.obj _ (rootModule P T))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) ≅
          (SheafExactDegreeZero.obj _ (P.frameTwistEtale T 1))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧,
      (∀ (U : T.Etaleᵒᵖ) (r : Residue P)
          (z : (T.rootsOfUnitySheaf P.diagonalExponent).obj.obj U),
        theta.hom.app U (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator (Residue P)
          P.diagonalExponent T (congrArg ULift.up (ZMod.natCast_self P.diagonalExponent))
            U r z) =
          Scheme.finiteEtaleTateOneGenerator P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent T
            P.diagonalExponent_annihilates U (scalar P r) z) ∧
      ((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
        (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology (scalar P))).homEquiv _ _)
          c.hom = SheafExactDegreeZero.scalarUnit T.smallEtaleTopology (scalar P)
            (rootModule P T) (P.frameTwistEtale T 1) theta ∧
      ((Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint
        (Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars T.smallEtaleTopology (scalar P))).homEquiv _ _)
          c2.hom = shiftedRootUnit P T theta
